resources.string: Singing unlocks at friendship level %1$d. Keep playing together!
Happy as a duck can be.
Hungry — a few seeds would help.
Lonely. It would like a stroke.
Put the duck on my screen
Allow the duck over other apps

Out on your screen it walks along the bottom over whatever you are using. Tap it, rub its head, pick it up and throw it, or hold your finger on it for food, a ball, tricks and a song. Drag it onto the ✕ to put it away.
One more step: Android blocked it

Because this app was installed from a file rather than a store, Android locks the "Display over other apps" switch and says "App was denied access".

To unlock it:
1. Tap Open app info below.
2. Tap ⋮ in the top-right corner and choose Allow restricted settings, then confirm.
3. Come back and tap the button again: the switch will work now.

If ⋮ has no such option, try the switch once more first; Android only offers it after it has refused once.
To walk over your other apps, the duck needs \"Display over other apps\". Turn on the switch for Virtual Duck, then come back.
Tap the duck to say hi, rub its head to pet it, double-tap to make it dance, tap the floor to call it over — or just talk to it.
🐣 Day %1$d together · look after it every day to start a streak
It can sing now: try 🎵 Sing.

When it is on, the duck listens for your voice and answers in duck, as many sounds as you said words. It only measures how loud the room is: nothing is recorded, nothing leaves your phone, and it listens only while it is on your screen.
Out on your screen. You can also hold the duck, tap 📍 and then tap anywhere: it walks there, or jumps up or down to live at that height.
Babble talks back in duck-speak, Duckling peeps, Squeaky squeaks like a bath toy. Tap one to hear it.
How big the duck is when it is out on your screen.

The duck is the Microduck by Pollen Robotics. Its motions were recorded from the robot\'s own walking, sitting, pecking, kicking and get-up policies, its voice is the robot\'s own synthesiser. 3D model © Pollen Robotics, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, adapted: decimated and converted to glTF. Not for sale.
